design_condition: The new clinic is set inside the plot with an offset relationship to the existing buildings, forming a compact courtyard ensemble and a clear forecourt while leaving a substantial western area as an open landscape and park.

positive.statement: The compact overall figure appropriately preserves the scale of the district and places the higher new building at a necessary distance from the edges.
The offset creates a well-sized forecourt with a clear address for both parts of the building.
The elongated park is a good and precise response to urban cold-air corridors and ecological connections.
The spatial organization is clearly derived from the duality of clinic and teaching and forms an internally coherent organism.
The common forecourt leads to a spacious entrance room with well-located reception and cafeteria.
The separation of staff and patient traffic flows is organized in the desired form.
The teaching area develops its own identity through its attractive connection and separate access.
The project is convincing in its urban planning and consistency with the interior organization.
The compact shape and area-efficient implementation of the program support sustainability.

negative.statement: The entrance area appears large and its design potential has not yet been explored.
The park formulation is not understood, and the floodplain-landscape gesture seems arbitrary and overloaded.
The park has too much surface area and lacks the green spaces typical of the district.
The high proportion of floor-to-ceiling glazing is architecturally unnecessary and very problematic from an energy perspective.
The facade design of the existing building in the new courtyard remains unresolved.
The double and two-track vertical access seems complicated and goes far beyond functionality flows of people.
The intervention in the existing building is structurally risky or even questionable in places.
The proposed building envelope cannot achieve the required energy standard.
The facade constructions and joints are not robust in terms of building physics and carry an inherent risk of damage.
